properties.description: Detects unexpected role assignments including Owner, Contributor, or User Access Administrator at subscription or management group scope.
properties.query:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue == 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write'
| where ActivityStatusValue == 'Success'
| extend RoleId = tostring(parse_json(Properties).requestbody)
| where RoleId contains 'Owner' or RoleId contains '8e3af657' or RoleId contains '18d7d88d'
